title: Incident handling lifecycle
citation: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 2 Computer Security Incident Handling Guide
midnight_summary: Incident response documents should define repeatable preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident improvement activities.
raw_text: Incident handling typically includes preparation; detection and analysis; containment, eradication, and recovery; and post-incident activity.

title: Application security verification requirements
midnight_summary: Application security standards should define verification expectations for authentication, session management, access control, validation, cryptography, error handling, logging, and API protections.
raw_text: The OWASP Application Security Verification Standard provides a basis for testing web application technical security controls and provides developers with a list of requirements for secure development.

title: ATT&CK-informed detection engineering context
midnight_summary: Detection engineering documents should connect alert logic, data sources, threat behaviors, validation, tuning, and operational feedback loops to observable adversary techniques.
raw_text: MITRE ATT&CK is a globally-accessible knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques based on real-world observations.
